claim_text: CausalCache reallocates exactly B active history-image slots over a complete summary trace; it does not add images or delete event summaries.
comparison: Recent-B versus CausalCache at matched B; unit is one decision prompt.
effect: Protocol identity: both arms contain B active history images.
notes: This is a protocol/property claim, not an empirical performance claim; k is realized, not preset.

claim_text: HGKV creates selective use of relevant restored pixels while staying inside the preregistered recent/wrong drift envelope.
comparison: HGKV v4 selected checkpoint versus its own frozen arms on 94 desktop development groups at B=1.
uncertainty: 95% CI for DiD select [+0.0162,+0.0294]; both drifts below epsilon=0.02.
notes: B0 parity is bitwise exact; do not generalize this desktop gate directly to closed-loop task success.

claim_text: CausalCache attains the highest zero-shot MobileWorld full-roster three-run mean and improves over HGKV+Recent-4.

effect: +6.6 percentage points (36.8% versus 30.2%); CausalCache succeeds on 43/117 tasks in each round.

claim_text: CausalCache improves MobileWorld success on the construction-defined memory-critical split.
comparison: CausalCache versus Recent-4 at B=4; 62 construction-defined cross-app memory-candidate tasks.
effect: +11.3 percentage points by the unrounded paired estimate (30.6% versus 19.4%; the main table displays +11.2 from rounded rates); CausalCache succeeds on 19/62 tasks in each round.
revision: legacy frozensel key corrected to HGKV+selector; three identical round counts confirmed 2026-07-31
notes: The split is construction-defined and not selected after seeing per-task outcomes.

claim_text: CausalCache is statistically indistinguishable from Recent-4 on the matched MobileWorld control split.
comparison: CausalCache versus Recent-4 at B=4 on 55 matched single-app controls.
effect: +1.2 percentage points (43.6% versus 42.4%); CausalCache succeeds on 24/55 tasks in each round.
revision: legacy frozensel key corrected to HGKV+selector; three identical round counts confirmed 2026-07-31
notes: The interval crosses zero; say no detectable difference/statistically indistinguishable, not beneficial or equivalent.

claim_text: The proposal-conditioned two-pass selector comparator has a higher MobileWorld point estimate than the last-action single-pass efficiency branch.
comparison: Last-action one-pass versus the repeated proposal-conditioned selector comparator.
effect: Proposal conditioning is +4.8 percentage points over last-action conditioning.
notes: The interval crosses zero; the last-action path remains an efficiency branch, while proposal conditioning often incurs a second policy pass.
